== Biography ==
'''Margaret Glasgow''' was born about 1801 in County Antrim, Ireland. The estimate comes from her age of fifty in the surviving 1851 census.<ref name="Census1851">[http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1851/Antrim/Kilconway/Dunaghy/Glenleslie/23/ 1851 Census of Ireland], Glenleslie household 23.</ref>

The census records Margaret as the unmarried daughter of [[Glasgow-1367|Robert Glasgow]] in his Glenleslie household. Robert's wife [[Unknown-540856|Catherine]] was present, but the return does not separately state that Catherine was Margaret's mother.

Robert's will, dated 3 February 1851, directly calls Margaret “my daughter Margaret Glasgow”. He left his Glenleslie farm, livestock, furniture and farming utensils to her for life. After her death they were to be divided equally between James Young and [[Young-78755|Mary Young]], expressly described as Margaret's son and daughter.<ref name="RobertWill">Robert Glasgow of Glenleslie, will dated 3 February 1851 and proved 13 February 1854, National Archives of Ireland copy, [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSJ8-MQQJ?view=fullText FamilySearch image 229].</ref>

The will proves Margaret's father and children. It does not name the children's father or say that Margaret married. Her current surname therefore remains Glasgow.== Research Notes ==

=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1367]] is assessed at 99% (proved). The 1851 Glenleslie household 23 transcription explicitly records Margaret, daughter50 relative to Robert Glasgow. Robert’s 3 February 1851 will independently calls Margaret his daughter.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Compare the complete original return, including absent members, with the transcription.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSJ8-MQQJ?view=fullText Robert Glasgow of Glenleslie, will dated 3 February 1851 and proved 13 February 1854, National Archives of Ireland copy, FamilySearch image 229 (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSJ8-MQQJ?view=fullText).]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.



The same-name [[Young-23682|James Young]], born about 1837 in Ireland and later associated with Philadelphia, is a possible profile for Margaret's son, but no record presently connects him to Glenleslie. A separate profile should not be created or attached until that identity is resolved.

Margaret is distinct from [[Glasgow-1053|Margaret (Glasgow) Winters]], whose profile preserves a separate Canadian Winters family formerly conflated with the unmarried Glenleslie woman.
